{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]]

'''Hawthorn Tea''' is a sweetened [[Cookbook:Beverages|beverage]] made from [[Cookbook:Hawthorn|hawthorn]], herbs, and lemon juice. It is thought by some to improve the immune system, and to alleviate symptoms of flu and sore throat.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*1 hawthorn tea bag 
*1 one small sprig [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]] (just the leaves)
*1 one small sprig [[Cookbook:Sage|sage]] (just the leaves)
*7 thin slices of fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Soup Spoon|soupspoons]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*5 soupspoons [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

==Procedure==

# Combine the water, tea bag, rosemary, sage, and ginger. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] briefly, then remove from heat and let [[Cookbook:Steeping|steep]] for 5–10 minutes.
# Filter the tea to remove solids, and mix in the sugar and the lemon juice.
# Cool and serve.
